name: io.github.kesperinc/moosim-metaphysics
title: Moosim Metaphysics — Korean Saju, Da Liu Ren & Compatibility
description: Korean Saju, Da Liu Ren (720 Gwa), Compatibility, Taekil & HR Synergy MCP (ko/en/ja/zh).

tools.name: get_saju
tools.description: Compute Korean Four Pillars of Destiny (Saju 원국/대운/오행/신살) with solar normalization. Supports lang=ko|en|ja|zh.

gender.description: Biological gender used for major luck (Daeun) direction

is_lunar.description: Set true if the provided birth date is in the lunar calendar

is_leap.description: Set true only if is_lunar is true and the birth month is a lunar leap month

lang.description: Response output language (ko, en, ja, or zh)

tools.name: get_yukim_divination
tools.description: Compute classical Korean Da Liu Ren (대육임 720과전) Four Lessons and Three Transmissions.

date_str.description: Target divination datetime as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' (optional, defaults to current KST)

tz_offset.description: Timezone UTC offset in hours (default 9.0 for KST Asia/Seoul)

latitude.description: Observer geographic latitude in decimal degrees (optional solar offset)

longitude.description: Observer geographic longitude in decimal degrees (optional true solar time)

is_lunar.description: Set true if date_str represents a lunar date

is_leap.description: Set true if is_lunar is true and the month is a leap month

lang.description: Response output language (ko, en, ja, or zh)

tools.name: get_taekil
tools.description: Find top auspicious solar dates (황도길일·손없는날·개인 귀인 택일) for moving, opening, marriage, surgery or childbirth.

start_date.description: Search window start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today KST)

days.description: Number of days to evaluate starting from start_date (default 30)

purpose.description: Event purpose category for auspicious date scoring

birth_year.description: Optional client solar birth year for personalized Nobleman matching

gender.description: Client gender for personalized Saju harmony evaluation

top_k.description: Maximum number of top ranked auspicious dates to return (default 5)

lang.description: Response output language (ko, en, ja, or zh)

tools.name: get_gunghap
tools.description: Analyze relationship compatibility using both Saju harmony and Da Liu Ren upper/lower spirits & affinity timing.

my_birth.description: Primary person's solar birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format

partner_birth.description: Partner person's solar birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format

lang.description: Response output language (ko, en, ja, or zh)

tools.name: get_naming_analysis
tools.description: Evaluate Korean name 81-stroke fortune, Five-Element harmony and Saju complementation.

last_name.description: Korean surname in Hangul or Hanja (e.g. 金 or 김)

name_hangul.description: Given name in Korean Hangul syllables without surname (e.g. 지수)

gender.description: Owner gender used to evaluate Saju element balance

lang.description: Response output language (ko, en, ja, or zh)

tools.name: search_classic_rag
tools.description: Search classical Da Liu Ren and Myeongri texts (육임직지·필법부·용어집) for scholarly citations.

query.description: Search keyword or classical metaphysics concept term

limit.description: Maximum number of matching classical passages to return (default 5)

lang.description: Response output language (ko, en, ja, or zh)

tools.name: get_raajeong_brief
tools.description: Predict client visit purpose (래정 훅 브리핑) for a specific time branch and birth profile.

target_date_str.description: Consultation target solar date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today KST)

time_branch.description: Consultation Earthly Branch hour (e.g. 子, 丑, 午) or empty for current slot

bonmyeong.description: Client birth-year Ganzhi stem-branch (e.g. 庚午) for natal spirit mapping

haengnyeon.description: Client current age-year Ganzhi (행년) for annual spirit mapping

lang.description: Response output language (ko, en, ja, or zh)

tools.name: get_hr_synergy
tools.description: Compare job candidates or team members against leader birth chart for B2B HR synergy.

leader_birth_date.description: Team leader or executive solar birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format

candidates.description: List of candidate objects with name, birth_date (YYYY-MM-DD), and gender

lang.description: Response output language (ko, en, ja, or zh)

tools.name: get_daily_nudge
tools.description: Compute personalized today fortune score, lucky color and retention push message.

target_date_str.description: Target date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional, defaults to today KST)

lang.description: Response output language (ko, en, ja, or zh)
